issues.issue: Unexplained local receipts recorded as other: 33% of the year's receipts (27,432 of 82,376). The review note says 14%, but that is the share of total resources including the beginning balance. For an SID this may be special assessments, but the form gives no breakdown.
No function is printed. The extractor rules give no function for SID operating expenses, so general government is an assumption (could be streets/utilities).
